product.name: RoadGuard Reflective Mirror
product.description: The RoadGuard Reflective Mirror is a lightweight, high‑visibility accessory designed to enhance driver awareness of vehicles in adjacent lanes. Constructed from durable polycarbonate with a polished aluminum frame, the mirror reflects traffic signals and rear‑view camera footage back to the driver. Installation requires only a standard mounting bracket and a quick‑release clip, making it suitable for both new and retrofit applications. Its bright red finish provides an eye‑catching contrast against the vehicle interior, while the reflective coating improves visibility during night driving. The product is engineered to withstand temperature fluctuations and resist fading, ensuring reliable performance over time.
